_note: Notional options for the S-3 space and backhaul layers. Costs are 15-year planning estimates (TBR).

options.name: Own LEO IoT smallsat constellation (about 24 sats, 15 deg inclination, 550 km)
options.latency: open sky: p95 wait 7.0 min (24 sats); under canopy (45 deg mask): p95 134.3 min
options.cost_basis: anchor: Kineis raised EUR 100M to fund a 25-nanosat IoT constellation (sourced); we assume about $100M per generation incl. launch and 4 gateways, 2 replenishments at 60%, $3M/yr operations (assumption). Low inclination needs dedicated small launches, not SSO rideshare at $7,000/kg.
pros: Sovereign control of spectrum and service
cons: Under-canopy links are slow without a relay

options.name: GEO hosted L-band broadcast payload
serves: MO-2 spoken alerts to every community
options.latency: continuous coverage; seconds from uplink to every receiver
options.cost_basis: anchor: USAF CHIRP hosted payload cost $65M vs about $500M for a dedicated satellite (sourced); we assume $80M incl. uplink and 15-year hosting (assumption). Precedent: AfriStar (1998-2018) broadcast L-band digital radio over Africa to portable receivers.
pros: One satellite covers the whole basin all the time
cons: Depends on finding a host satellite slot

options.name: Commercial broadband (Starlink) at hub, nodes and ranger stations
pros: High bandwidth for images, voice, video
cons: Licensed only in some basin countries (DRC 2025, CAR 2026; others verify)
Needs clear sky and about 50-100 W
Foreign commercial dependency: DRC banned it before licensing

options.name: Commercial Iridium SBD for sensors
options.cost_basis: $26.99/month plan + $50 activation (sourced, one reseller); module price not sourced
pros: Named interoperability target in the RFP
cons: Airtime cost scales with every terminal
Module cost likely above S3-04 $150 cap (verify)

options.name: Direct-to-cell text alerts (Airtel + Starlink)
serves: MO-2 supplementary channel to existing phones
pros: Reaches phones people already own (S3-07 objective)
cons: Only in Airtel markets with approval
Many people have no phone or no charge

options.name: Ranger-station tower as canopy-top relay (LoRa-class mesh to tower)
options.latency: seconds to the tower, then the satellite path
pros: Fixes the under-canopy latency problem the LEO model shows
Reuses the tower we build anyway
cons: Only within about 15-25 km of a station
